text: Decided not to mark OPS (or any table) @optable: op-declarations answers none of the ~1030 ops it declares (their owners do), the names are built at run time from hand rows, 60-odd families with seven share files, aliases and owners' registered declarations, and every export is a lazy proxy the reader sees as anything, so a hand-written list of names could not be checked against the code and would make this module a second answerer of each owner's op names (rule 7). Kinds of the tables are stated exactly; the names stay content.

kindsUndetermined.why: affordances (not commented, not a module the tool lists here) builds them; its ACTS rows and RUNGS table hold values of several shapes, so written as *

falseStarts: Wrote classes, machineClasses and stamps as exact unions ('admin'|'member'|'probe'|'daemon', the eleven stamp names): every `.includes(someString)` in tests and users, and every owner row written without as-const, became a refusal; widened to readonly string[] with a @bound line naming the closed set

Wrote the session sets as ReadonlySet<string>: it lacks the refusing add/delete/clear the tests call and claims ES2025 set methods FrozenSet does not have; rewrote as Iterable<string> & an explicit method list
corrections: QUERY helpers in t48.mjs and t50.mjs given @param {string} key so the families' actor key is no longer anything
notes: Listing 'anything' lines: 114 before, 4 after (all from affordances' fields written *). +89 refusals: 16 bound lines without tests (expected); 73 in this module's own tests where the tests do what the stated kind forbids or the reader cannot follow them: 33 tests that index the module namespace by a name from a list (O[name].includes, now a union of every export's kind), 19 reads of a field that may be null/undefined without a check (classes null on a public op, machineClasses optional, actor null), 10 deliberate writes to frozen data inside assert.throws (purity, R5, R69 tests), 10 tuple/find inferences in tests, 1 `{}` built by assignment passed to registerDeclaredOps. None says a comment is false of the code. Every one of the 107 exports is a lazy Proxy the reader sees as anything, so the stated kinds are attached with @type on each export and nothing in the module can check them against build(). No @optable: see the note. The share/family constants of the public t48/t50/t51 files and REAUTH_ACTS (t47) keep their inferred frozen literal kinds, which are already exact (op names and kinds, but also each cite string). sourceLinesRead counts index.mjs (~1450 lines read in parts), compose/declared/t47/t48/t51 (~240) and affordances' decorate (~30); I also read ~200 lines of call sites in users and ~900 lines of the brief, the proof's rules and the tool's listing/usage code, not counted there. testLinesRead: ~40 lines of tests read to judge the new refusals.

checkRefusalsBefore is the real after state, checkRefusalsAfter the commented after state. No comment changed: the change adds and retires op names, which are content under my first-step decision. The +91 over the real state are the same categories as the first step plus one nullable read in the new notice-membership-77 test.
